info.title: Tarcza Polska API
info.description:
Backend for the Tarcza Polska civil resilience platform.

* `/api/v1/*` - Citizen mobile app (Flutter). Authenticate with the JWT returned by `POST /api/v1/devices`.
* `/api/command/*` - Command Center. Authenticate with the JWT returned by `POST /api/command/login`.

All spatial payloads are GeoJSON (WGS84, `[lng, lat]` order). Every error is an `ErrorResponse`.
`GET /map`, `GET /verifications/pending` and `GET /alerts` send an `ETag`; repeat the value in
`If-None-Match` to get `304 Not Modified`.

field.description: Name of the body field (maps 1:1 onto the form field)

code.description: Stable machine-readable code: bad_request, unauthorized, token_expired, forbidden, not_found, conflict, gone, verification_already_answered, verification_expired, validation_failed, too_many_requests, internal_error.

retryAfter.description: Seconds until the next attempt may succeed (429 only, also sent as the Retry-After header)

GeoJsonGeometry.description: GeoJSON geometry in WGS84, coordinates ordered [lng, lat].

coordinates.description: Point: [lng, lat]; Polygon: [[[lng, lat], ...]]; MultiPolygon: [[[[lng, lat], ...]]]

ReportScope.description: area = polygon of cells; point = one object (fuel station / shelter)

ShelterAvailability.description: Opening regime from the national register

PoiRef.description: The object a point-scoped report / incident / question is about.

ShelterOccupancy.description: Room left in an open shelter

locationRefresh.description: Receive the location_refresh reminder push (default true)

lastLocation.description: Point or null until the first location update

h3Cell.description: H3 cell (resolution 9) of the stored position

agreementPct.description: Share of answers confirming the problem; null until somebody answered

IncidentSummary.description: Public incident fields shared by IncidentView and the map feature properties.

poi.description: scope=point: the station / shelter this incident is about

area.description: Polygon / MultiPolygon of verified cells; null while the incident is only detected

IncidentTimelineEntry.description: One entry of the public incident history. `details` holds small, type-specific facts (counts, levels), never positions.

details.description: e.g. {reports} for created, {ring, cells, devices} for wave_started, {positiveCells, negativeCells, unknownCells, yes, no} for area_changed, {from, to, score} for confidence_changed

fuels.description: Fuel types sold (or ever reported) at this station with current availability

shortage.description: At least one fuel type currently reported missing

distanceMeters.description: Only in GET /fuel-stations?lat&lng and the offline bundle

geometry.description: incident (scope=area): polygon, centroid Point while the area is empty; incident (scope=point): Point at the object; shelter / fuel_station: Point; alert: polygon

poiKind.description: For point types: which object picker to show

fuelTypes.description: Non-empty only for fuel_shortage: the fuel-type choices to show

poi.description: The station / shelter the report was bound to (point types)

PhotoAccepted.description: Returned right after a photo upload; analysis runs in the background and is visible to operators only.

incident.description: null until clustering (asynchronous, usually within seconds) attached the report to an incident

poi.description: Point verification: the station / shelter the question is about (show its name; it may be a neighbour of the reported one)

thanks.description: Polish thank-you line to show the user

OfflineBundle.description: Snapshot to cache for degraded / offline mode around one position.

validUntil.description: Refresh after this time (24 h) or on foreground

incidentId.title: Incident whose current area becomes the alert area (if `area` is omitted).

occupancy.title: Only meaningful with status=open: plenty | limited | full.

locationRefresh.title: Receive the "are you still in this area?" reminder when the position is stale. Default on.

poiId.title: Point types (fuel_shortage, shelter_issue): the station / shelter the report is about. Omitted = nearest one.

fuelTypes.title: fuel_shortage only: which fuels are missing (pb95, pb98, diesel, lpg). Required for that type.

occupancy.title: Only meaningful with status=open: plenty | limited | full.
